title: fix(lint)!: the object publish door refuses an object whose own list view sorts by a field the list door refuses (#30095)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXQyiKbpV3REQxogrr
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJrQp25DwmU8PpHXY7H6t15)_
Fixes #30095

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — an object write the door accepted before is refused: an object whose built-in `listViews.*.sort` names a field the list door answers `400 INVALID_SORT` now saves `422 INVALID_METADATA`.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` names no `sortable` field key, and `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` lists the doors by rule family, not by reference-integrity member, so it names no object crossing to correct; the prescription ships in the refusal text.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 对象自带的列表视图（`listViews.*.sort`）如果按一个列表门会拒绝的字段排序（字段声明了 `sortable: false`、是公式字段、或对象根本没有这个字段），对象发布门现在直接拒收，返回 422 `INVALID_METADATA`，规则名 `sort-field-unsortable` 或 `sort-field-unknown`，指到具体排序键路径，不存任何行。
- **为什么改：** 以前 `os validate` 会报错，视图门和页面门也会拒，唯独对象门不查：Studio 里存对象照样成功，那个列表视图每次打开都答 `400 INVALID_SORT`。
- **风险与回滚：** 这是收窄：以前能存的这类对象，下次保存会被拒；已存的对象照常加载，另一个对象的写入不会因为已存的违规对象被拒。上线前普查了仓库里全部 127 个对象、102 个列表视图、113 个排序键，0 命中。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts` 里 `validateSortableFields` 那一行（`runtimeTypes` 加了 `object`）和它上方的 #30095 注释；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` 末尾的 #30095 用例；`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts` 的成员清单钉子。
- **两分钟验证：** 运行 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts -t 30095`，预期 3 个全绿：`sortable: false` 与不存在的字段各被 422 拒绝、没有存下任何行；对照组按可排序字段保存成功。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`validateSortableFields` declares `object` in its `runtimeTypes`** (`packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`). The `validateReferenceIntegrity` entry already dispatches on `object` writes (#15254); the member axis decides which members judge that snapshot, and this member was the one list-view sibling #15495 held back for its own adjudication. Its first rung walks `objects[].listViews.*.sort`, so the object publish door (`PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME`; Studio, REST, MCP) now gives an object's own list view sort the verdicts `os validate`, the `view` door and the `page` door already give it: `sort-field-unsortable` (`sortable: false`, a virtual `formula`) and `sort-field-unknown`, both `error`, refused `422 INVALID_METADATA`, nothing stored.
- **Why it is safe (the #15254 / #9313 terms).** The member resolves only against `stack.objects`, the collection every per-write snapshot carries, so it has no missing-collection false-positive channel; its `views[]` and `pages[]` rungs find nothing on an object snapshot. The gate's differential (#4463 D4) still never charges a stored sibling's violation to this write.
- **Rollout measurement, before crossing** (base `c045c341`, through the door's own shape: `runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, type `object`, every other corpus object as context): 122 `*.object.ts` files under `packages/` and `examples/`, 127 objects, 45 of them carrying 102 built-in list views with 113 sort keys — **0 findings, precision 1.0**. The same sweep's synthetic probe (a list view sorting by a `sortable: false` field) drew `sort-field-unsortable` from the rule and nothing from the door: the defect, measured. The member note carries the population.
- `authoring-rules.ts` is not touched: the entry already lists `object`.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts`: the member-surface pin now lists `validateSortableFields` among the members that declare `object` (it used to assert the opposite and say this is where the adjudication has to be made); three refusals through the door's gate (`sortable: false`, `formula`, an unknown name), each one error at `objects.leave_request.listViews.inbox.sort[0]`; CONTROL: the same list view sorting by a field with no `sortable` key and by a `sortable: true` field publishes with the suite run.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` (#30095), through the real `saveMetaItem` object publish route: `sortable: false` refused `422` / `INVALID_METADATA`, one `sort-field-unsortable` issue at `error` at the sort key path, `rulesRun` names `validateReferenceIntegrity`, no active row; an unknown name refused the same way as `sort-field-unknown`; CONTROL: the same object sorting by a sortable field saves one row.

## Acceptance notes

- `Metadata-protocol: none` is the claim's line, copied. Reading for the seat: nothing an author may write changes, because `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` already refused this sort; only the runtime door's accept set narrows, which the `(narrowing)` arm and the BREAKING banner carry. #30270 declared `narrowed` because it moved the CLI verdict too.
- Draft saves (`?mode=draft`) are not judged, unchanged (#4716 D1).

## Verification

All readings on head `0e5a281c` (base `c045c341`, the #30270 merge).

- **Reproduced before the change** (`fa9c0aa2` and again on `c045c341`): through the same `saveMetaItem` harness, an object whose list view sorts by a `sortable: false` field saved (`success: true`, one active row), and so did one sorting by `gone_field`; `validateReferenceIntegrity` on the same body reported `sort-field-unsortable` at `error` (`objects[0].listViews.inbox.sort[0]`). The read half (`400 INVALID_SORT` at the list door for `sortable: false`) is pinned by `packages/rest/src/data-sort-field-sortable-flag-door.test.ts` (#29896).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 195 passed (195), Tests 8086 passed (8086). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 316 passed, 4 skipped (320); Tests 22434 passed, 26 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 58 derived, 58 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every exit code 0 (four dist-reading gates, `check:type-check-debt` and the teardown self-test re-run after a full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` and a deepening fetch; their first run was exit 3, prerequisite not met, not red).
- **Dogfood** (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, after building its closure; the title carries `!`): Test Files 420 passed, 3 skipped (423); Tests 3496 passed, 36 skipped (3532). VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Ablation** (one, on the tested behaviour): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the member's `'object'` with a marker type (`ablate30095`) in `reference-integrity-suite.ts`; `@objectstack/lint` rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in all 4 built entry files. Result: `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts` 4 failed / 37 passed (the member-surface pin and the three refusals), the door suite `-t 30095` 2 failed / 1 passed (both refusals red, the object saved; the control green). Restored by the tool (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), lint rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean on all 20 built files, working tree clean, door suite 3/3 green again.
